description: Broad economic-growth legislation advancing on Beacon Hill contains various local nuggets of note—among them $150,000 for downtown Wenham improvements, $100,000 for Hamilton Town Hall renovations, and land-development-review measures that have stirred debate in a North Shore state legislative race.

title: ICYMI: Emerging Economic Growth Bill Could Have Lots Of Local Implications — Kristin Kassner for State Representative
